title: Comprehensive Agent Health Services
description: Replace trivial healthProbe() stubs with layered diagnostic-grade checks inherited from Base*Agent and extended per-agent. Fast mode runs on cron; deep mode (Workers AI round-trip) is user-triggered only.

tasks.title: Create HealthReport and HealthCheck types
tasks.description: Define HealthReport, HealthCheck, HealthMode, HealthStatus interfaces per PLAN.md §HealthReport Shape. Export from agent-support/index.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: Interfaces exported and importable from @/ai/providers/agent-support.

tasks.title: Create parallel check runner with per-check timeout
tasks.description: Export runChecks(fns: Array<() => Promise<HealthCheck>>, opts: { timeoutMs: number }): Promise<HealthCheck[]>. Each fn wrapped in Promise.race with timeout; timeout produces a fail HealthCheck, not a throw. Aggregate pass/fail/skip counts outside runner.
tasks.success_criteria: Runner returns all results even if individual checks hang; no single check can block > timeoutMs.

tasks.title: Implement B1–B7 base check factories
tasks.description: Export a factory per check: bindingSanity(env, required, optional), aiProviderInit(ai), stateStoreRoundTrip(stateStore, agentName, env.DB), skillManagerReachability(ai, skills), edigraphConnectivity(memory), hitlQueueDryRun(env.DB, agentName), collabBindingResolution(env, peerBindings). Each returns a () => Promise<HealthCheck>. StateStore round-trip writes/reads/cleans up a sentinel row; mirror verification via D1 SELECT on agentStateMirror.
tasks.success_criteria: Each factory returns a check function; fail cases produce HealthCheck with error + details; skip used for optional bindings absent.

tasks.title: Implement C1–C3 chat-specific check factories
tasks.description: Export aiChatAgentInternals(agent), streamShapeSanity() [uses AbortSignal.timeout(0) — no tokens], workersAiChatRoundTrip(env) [DEEP MODE ONLY — real streamText call with 10s timeout]. Round-trip reads first decoded chunk, reports total ms, verifies non-empty text.
tasks.success_criteria: streamShapeSanity passes in fast mode without consuming tokens; workersAiChatRoundTrip only called when mode=deep.

tasks.title: Export health module from agent-support barrel
tasks.description: Create health/index.ts re-exporting types, runner, base-checks, chat-checks. Add re-exports to agent-support/index.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: `import { runChecks, HealthReport } from '@/ai/providers/agent-support'` compiles.

tasks.title: Replace trivial healthProbe() in BaseAgent
tasks.description: Replace the current healthProbe() method. Add `protected abstract get peerAgentBindings(): Record<string, { bindingKey: string; required: boolean }>` (default {}). Add `protected async agentHealthChecks(mode: HealthMode): Promise<HealthCheck[]>` (default returns []). The new @callable() healthProbe(opts?: { mode?: HealthMode }) runs: B1 bindingSanity, B2 aiProviderInit, B3 stateStoreRoundTrip, B4 skillManagerReachability, B5 edigraphConnectivity (skip if no memory), B6 hitlQueueDryRun, B7 collabBindingResolution — via runChecks with 1500ms fast / 10000ms deep timeout. Merges in agentHealthChecks(mode). Aggregates into HealthReport with overall status (any fail → degraded; all required fail → unhealthy).
tasks.success_criteria: BaseAgent.healthProbe() returns a HealthReport with >=7 checks; runs under 2s in fast mode; no trivial `{status: 'ok'}` paths remain.

tasks.title: Replace trivial healthProbe() in BaseChatAgent
tasks.description: Same abstract additions as BaseAgent plus: fast mode runs B1–B7 + C1 aiChatAgentInternals + C2 streamShapeSanity; deep mode additionally runs C3 workersAiChatRoundTrip. Preserves the peerAgentBindings and agentHealthChecks hooks. Remove the existing stub healthProbe() at the bottom of base-chat-agent.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: Fast probe returns >=9 checks with no token consumption; deep probe adds one model-category check with non-zero durationMs.

tasks.title: CloudflareAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: Implement peerAgentBindings (GITHUB_AGENT required for wrangler scanning). Implement agentHealthChecks: cf docs MCP reachable (HEAD fast / real search deep); CF API accounts list (HEAD fast / GET deep); wrangler.jsonc/wrangler.toml parser loads; sentinel known-worker lookup via workers_get_worker (deep only); CF docs MCP listed in env.MCP registry. Refactor existing health.ts to return HealthCheck[].
tasks.success_criteria: Fast mode has >=3 CF-specific checks without network calls beyond HEAD; deep mode includes at least one real CF API GET.

tasks.title: EngineerAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: CLOUDFLARE_AGENT, GUARDRAIL_AGENT (both required). agentHealthChecks: Jules MCP reachable (HEAD + list tools deep); JULES_SESSION_MANAGER DO binding resolves; GitHub API /user (HEAD fast / GET deep); Jules-orchestration skill resolves.
tasks.success_criteria: Checks cover Jules MCP + peer bindings + GitHub auth.

tasks.title: GuardrailAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: CLOUDFLARE_AGENT, ENGINEER_AGENT (required). agentHealthChecks: golden-path rule set loaded (COUNT(*) > 0); code-standards skill resolves; cloudflare-standards skill resolves. Refactor existing health.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: Rule set count check passes when rules loaded; peer bindings resolve.

tasks.title: GithubAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: agentHealthChecks: GitHub App installation token obtainable (fast: credential shape only; deep: actual token fetch); Octokit constructs without error; webhook signature verifier loaded. Refactor existing health.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: Fast mode skips real token exchange; deep mode performs actual auth round-trip.

tasks.title: WorkshopAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: DESIGN_AGENT, ENGINEER_AGENT, CLOUDFLARE_AGENT, GUARDRAIL_AGENT (all required). agentHealthChecks: jules-stitch-loop skill resolves; collaboration service dry-run (insert collaboration_sessions row with status='health-probe', immediately delete — wrapped in D1 batch).
tasks.success_criteria: All four peer bindings must resolve; dry-run session row does not persist.

tasks.title: DesignAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: ENGINEER_AGENT (required). agentHealthChecks: Stitch MCP reachable (HEAD); stitch-pipeline skill resolves; ui-design skill resolves.
tasks.success_criteria: Stitch MCP HEAD returns 2xx in fast mode.

tasks.title: ResearchAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: agentHealthChecks: search provider API HEAD; Vectorize binding resolves (env.VECTORIZE.describe() or equivalent); research skills (plan-writing, brainstorming) resolve.
tasks.success_criteria: Vectorize binding check passes when configured.

tasks.title: LearningAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: ENGINEER_AGENT (required). agentHealthChecks: CI healer queue table queryable; HitlQueue type='ci-heal' SELECT works. Refactor methods/health.ts.
tasks.success_criteria: HITL type-specific query returns a count.

tasks.title: OrchestratorAgent specialized health checks
tasks.description: peerAgentBindings: every other canonical agent binding (all required). agentHealthChecks: orchestration skill resolves; task assignment table queryable; existing checkOrchestrationHealth export adapted to return HealthCheck[] consumable from this probe.
tasks.success_criteria: Peer binding count matches agent taxonomy (>=9).

tasks.title: CollaborationSpace specialized health checks
tasks.description: agentHealthChecks: thread_participants table queryable; chat subscribers table queryable; room DDL up-to-date (schema version check if applicable).
tasks.success_criteria: Both participant and subscriber tables return counts.

tasks.title: Fix StandardizationAgent trivial healthProbe (user-flagged)
tasks.description: Replace `async healthProbe() { return { status: 'ok', ... } }` with proper inheritance. If this class does not yet extend BaseAgent, migrate it. peerAgentBindings: GUARDRAIL_AGENT (required). agentHealthChecks: standardization rule set loaded; style-guide skill resolves; agent_inventory table queryable. This is the exemplar the user explicitly called out.
tasks.success_criteria: StandardizationAgent.healthProbe returns a HealthReport with >=10 checks; no trivial `{ status: 'ok' }` path remains.

tasks.title: OverseerAgent specialized health checks (if not dissolved)
tasks.description: If OverseerAgent still exists (v5/followup may have dissolved it into EngineerAgent + GuardrailAgent), add agentHealthChecks covering its Jules monitoring responsibilities. If dissolved, skip this task.
tasks.success_criteria: Either OverseerAgent has layered health checks, or task is explicitly documented as N/A because agent was dissolved.

tasks.title: Create checkAgentsHealthDetailed for coordinator
tasks.description: New export: iterates the AGENTS_SDK_AGENTS list (move from existing agent-support/health.ts or reuse). For each: getAgentByName → stub.healthProbe({ mode: 'fast' }) with 2s per-agent timeout. Aggregates per-agent HealthReports into a single HealthStepResult consumable by the coordinator. Summary includes per-agent status + counts of passed/failed checks.
tasks.success_criteria: Returns HealthStepResult with overall status = 'success' only if all agents healthy, 'warning' if any degraded, 'failure' if any unhealthy.

tasks.title: Swap coordinator's agents check to detailed version
tasks.description: Replace `import { checkHealth as checkAgentsHealth } from '@/ai/providers'` with the new detailed import. Update CODE_CHECKS entry `{ id: 'agents', ... }` to use checkAgentsHealthDetailed. Keep 8s PER_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS — detailed check must complete within that budget (~11 agents × 2s each won't fit serially; the detailed check MUST parallelize the per-agent probes).
tasks.success_criteria: Coordinator runs complete within existing deadlines; agents step shows per-agent detail in results.details.

tasks.title: POST /api/agents/:agentName/health route
tasks.description: New Hono route. Path param :agentName resolves to a binding via static mapping. Query ?mode=fast|deep (default fast). Calls getAgentByName(binding, 'health-probe') and invokes stub.healthProbe({ mode }) with 30s timeout in deep mode. Returns HealthReport as JSON. Auth: existing admin guard pattern. Mount in routes/api/agents/index.ts (create if absent).
tasks.success_criteria: Route responds with HealthReport shape; deep mode successfully includes Workers AI round-trip check.

tasks.title: Deprecate old agent-support/health.ts
tasks.description: After C2 is in place and verified, either delete the old checkHealth or reduce it to a thin re-export pointing to the new detailed version. Do not orphan callers.
tasks.success_criteria: No remaining imports of the old `checkHealth` from `@/ai/providers` except the new entry point.

tasks.title: Grep for remaining trivial healthProbe stubs
tasks.description: Run: `rg -n "status:\s*['\"]ok['\"]" src/backend/src/ai/agents/` and `rg -n "healthProbe\(\)\s*\{" src/backend/src/ai/agents/` — audit every hit. Any that just return `{ status: 'ok' }` must be migrated. Document findings. Fix or ticket each.
tasks.success_criteria: Zero trivial healthProbe stubs remain across ai/agents/ tree (excluding base classes).

tasks.title: Zero TypeScript errors
tasks.description: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in repo root; zero errors.
tasks.success_criteria: Command exits 0.

tasks.title: Confirm cron runs consume zero Workers AI tokens
tasks.description: Deploy to preview. Trigger coordinator via `POST /api/health/run`. Check AI Gateway analytics for the time window — there should be ZERO @cf/meta/llama-3.3 requests attributed to health probes. Confirms fast mode never calls C3.
tasks.success_criteria: AI Gateway shows no llama-3.3 traffic during health runs unless ?mode=deep was used.

tasks.title: Deep-mode probe includes model round-trip
tasks.description: curl `POST /api/agents/OrchestratorAgent/health?mode=deep` — response MUST include a check with category='model' and non-zero durationMs.
tasks.success_criteria: Exactly one model-category check present with status='pass' and durationMs > 0.

tasks.title: Negative tests produce real failures
tasks.description: In a preview env, unbind EDGRAPH (optional → expect skip), unbind a required peer (expect fail), insert a bad skill name into an agent's skills list (expect B4 fail). Verify each produces the correct HealthCheck outcome.
tasks.success_criteria: Each negative case reports the expected status (skip vs fail) with actionable error message.

notes: Parallel groups in execution_order use [brackets]. All agents in phase 3 can be modified in parallel once base classes are updated.
Layer 3 per-agent checks MUST NOT duplicate Layer 2 inherited checks (don't re-verify env.DB — that's B1).
The ONLY place Workers AI is called during a probe is C3, and ONLY when mode=deep.
StandardizationAgent (A11) is the user-flagged exemplar — treat as a quality bar for the other agents.
Every agent under src/backend/src/ai/agents/ MUST own a non-trivial agentHealthChecks() by end of Phase 3. Use V2-GREP-TRIVIAL to verify.
